---
name: Auto Close Non-English Issues

on:
  issues:
    types:
      - opened
      - edited
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  detect-language:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install franc-min

      - name: Detect language and close if not English
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |-
          # Create a script to detect language that NEVER exits with non-zero
          echo "const franc = require('franc-min').franc || require('franc-min');

          const text = process.argv[2] || '';

          try {
            const lang = franc(text, { minLength: 10 });
            if (lang !== 'eng') {
              console.log(\`Text: \${text}\`);
              console.log(\`Language detected: \${lang}. This is not English.\`);
              console.log('NON_ENGLISH');
            } else {
              console.log('Language detected: English.');
              console.log('ENGLISH');
            }
          } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error detecting language:', error.message);
            console.log('ERROR');
          }" > detect.js


          # Parse issue title, body, and number
          ISSUE_TITLE=$(jq -r '.issue.title' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          ISSUE_BODY=$(jq -r '.issue.body' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          ISSUE_NUMBER=${{ github.event.issue.number }}


          # Debug title, body, and number
          echo "Debug: ISSUE_TITLE='$ISSUE_TITLE'"
          echo "Debug: ISSUE_BODY='$ISSUE_BODY'"
          echo "Debug: ISSUE_NUMBER='$ISSUE_NUMBER'"


          # Function to check language and close issue if needed
          check_and_close() {
            local text="$1"
            local field_name="$2"

            if [ -n "$text" ] && [ "$text" != "null" ]; then
              echo "Checking $field_name..."


              # Run detection and capture the output
              result=$(node detect.js "$text" | tail -1)

              if [ "$result" = "NON_ENGLISH" ]; then
                echo "$field_name is not in English. Closing issue..."
                gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --body "Sorry, please open issues in English only. The $field_name was detected as non-English. This issue will be closed automatically."
                gh issue close "$ISSUE_NUMBER"
                echo "Issue closed successfully due to non-English content."
              fi
            else
              echo "$field_name is empty or null, skipping..."
            fi
          }


          # Check title first
          check_and_close "$ISSUE_TITLE" "title"


          # Check body second
          check_and_close "$ISSUE_BODY" "body"

          echo "Workflow completed successfully."

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
